messages:
maria: FYI: scheduling a short micro-maint window in eu-west1 on Wed 03:00 UTC. Purpose: NIC QoS calibration + GPU driver soft-restart across a small cohort. Expected per-node interruption ~90s max.

ajay: ack. what's the scope (#nodes / pools)? any tenant impact?

maria: scope: ~48 nodes across two racks in eu-west1-gpu-pool-b. We’ll do 4-node cohorts to keep observable capacity >95% for hosted API. Priority tenants: none pinned to this pool. Dedicated customers: they'll stay on reserved pools (no change).

olivia: quick Q — will this touch on-prem/private customers in the region (private deployments)?

maria: no, private control planes are untouched. Only hosted inference infra. For Dedicated, we verified the reserved capacity mapping — no scheduled nodes there.

leo: any changes to routing/failover so client SDKs don't see 5xx spikes?

maria: yes — applying short-circuit routing policy during maintenance: route requests from eu-west1 -> eu-central or us-east via cost-priority fallback for 3m windows per cohort. Also enabling per-model concurrency cap to reduce tail latency.

jasper: can we pre-warm a few standby GPUs to avoid cold-cache regressions? what's the overhead?

maria: plan: provision 6 warmback instances (ephemeral) in eu-central for 30m preheat. Estimated incremental cost: ~$320 total (preheat + spot backfill). We’ll deprovision immediately after window.

ajay: what about KV/prefix cache warm-seed — any guidance for model owners?

maria: model owners: if you rely on large prefix-caches, we recommend triggering a small synthetic traffic run 20m before your traffic spike. SRE will provide a warm-seed script.

leo: can you drop the preflight checklist here? I’ll run it before ops starts.

maria: preflight checklist (short):
1) run `./maint/preflight.sh eu-west1 rack-b` (returns 0)
2) ensure node health OK: `fleetctl health --rack rack-b --filter gpu`
3) set maintenance tag: `kubectl label nodes <node> infra.maint-window=2024-06-05T03:00Z --overwrite`
4) cordon+quiesce GPU processes: `ssh $NODE 'systemctl stop redwood-gpu-proxy; sleep 10'`
5) drain with eviction timeout: `kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60`

jasper: please add an automated rollback hook if tail qps or 5xx rises >3% above baseline for 5m.

maria: agreed — rollback hook will revert routing and uncordon remaining nodes. Also SRE will watch token-level latency dashboards.

sre-bot: Reminder: scheduled window recorded in Ops calendar. Reminder will post 30m before start.

olivia: one last ask — can we mute non-critical alerts for the window to avoid noise?

maria: yes — we'll suppress low-severity alerts for eu-west1 during the cohorts. Critical SLO alerts stay ON.

ajay: timeline and estimated user-visible impact?

maria: timeline: 03:00 UTC start, 12 cohorts of 4 nodes, cohort spacing 6m, total ~72 minutes. Each cohort: prepare (1m) -> quiesce+restart (2m) -> post-checks (3m). Expected user-visible blips: <0.5% increase in 5xx for short tails during route swaps.

leo: thanks — will help monitor. tagging ops-oncall: @jasper @leo

maria: final note: running a lightweight telemetry sweep after each cohort to ensure kernel NIC stats and GPU process counts return to baseline. I'll post runbook links and the preheat script in #eng-infra-apps 30m before start.
